title: CareLine Service Plans Cancellation and Refund Terms
content:
**Cancellation clause of the CareLine Service Plans agreement.**

The holder may cancel a plan at any time. A cancellation within the free-look period of the current term, when no visit was used in that term, refunds that term's plan fee in full. A full refund applies only when the plan is cancelled within the free-look period counted from the start of the current term. Calendar days are counted from the day after the term start date, and a cancellation on the last free-look day still qualifies. Any other cancellation refunds the term's plan fee times the full months remaining in the term over the months in the term, minus the plan's cancellation fee, never below zero. The refund names the plan fee charge it returns. Visit charges are never refunded on cancellation.

A plan that is active or past due may be cancelled; the cancellation date is recorded and the plan's status becomes cancelled. The free-look period, the months in the term and the cancellation fee are the figures the product schedules set for the plan's tier.

### Terms used in this clause

- **Current term** — the term that began on the term start date shown on the plan record.
- **A visit used in that term** — any service visit recorded on the plan in the current term, of any kind and with any outcome.
- **Refund** — a cancellation refund naming the plan fee charge of the term that it returns.

### Which refund applies

| Cancelled within the free-look period of the current term? | Any visit in the current term? | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | That term's plan fee in full |
| Yes | Yes | The prorated refund less the cancellation fee, never below zero |
| No | No | The prorated refund less the cancellation fee, never below zero |
| No | Yes | The prorated refund less the cancellation fee, never below zero |

### The free-look period on the calendar (hypothetical term start 1 May 2026, free-look period of 30 calendar days)

- Day 1 of the free-look period is 2 May 2026; the last free-look day is 31 May 2026.
- Cancelled on 31 May 2026 with no visit in the term: full refund.
- Cancelled on 1 June 2026: outside the free-look period; prorated refund.

### The prorated refund in words and figures

The prorated refund equals the term's plan fee multiplied by the full months remaining in the term and divided by the months in the term, less the plan's cancellation fee; where that result is below zero, the refund is zero.

| Hypothetical inputs | Refund |
|---|---|
| Term's plan fee 240.00; 12-month term; 5 full months remaining; cancellation fee 20.00 | 240.00 multiplied by 5 and divided by 12 is 100.00; less 20.00 gives 80.00 |
| Term's plan fee 240.00; 12-month term; 1 full month remaining; cancellation fee 30.00 | 240.00 multiplied by 1 and divided by 12 is 20.00; less 30.00 falls below zero, so the refund is 0.00 |

Trip fees, labor, parts, surcharges and no-show fees already billed stay billed when a plan is cancelled.
